fields.name: Aarohan '21 Website
fields.text_1: APOGEE(A Professions Oriented Gathering over Educational Experiences)- is BITS Pilani's annual technical extravaganza. From presenting papers and projects at the oldest-of-its-kind events in the country, developing amazing solutions to real-life cases and problems, exhibitions of the best contraptions that man has made, guest lectures that tell stories never heard before, to the college’s own literature festival, APOGEE challenges the intellect of the participants and piques the minds of the audience.
fields.text_2: Aarohan is a national-level examination crafted and conducted by the students of BITS Pilani. The examination is conducted for the classes of IX, X, XI, and XIIth. It is conducted in two rounds. The winners of round 1 are then invited to BITS Pilani to be a part of round 2. The winners of round 2 win cash prizes and much more. "

fields.text_2: Armageddon is the gaming event in APOGEE. This event brings together many gaming enthusiasts from colleges all over the country. It attracts a massive participation pool of around 1.5k-2k gamers every year. Games hosted during Armageddon are CS: GO, FIFA, Rainbow 6 Siege, PUBG Mobile, and Mini Militia.

fields.name: BOSM '19 Website
fields.text_1:
The BITS Open Sports Meet (BOSM) is the annual sports festival of BITS Pilani, Pilani Campus. This much awaited sporting extravaganza is a platform for college teams to exhibit their exceptional sporting talents and compete for superiority!
Since its first edition way back in 1986, it has grown to be one of the largest and most competitive college sports fests in the country. "
fields.text_2: This was the Official Website for BOSM'19. It was aimed to ease the Registration process for the people participating in the fest. It has many other sections like the details of all the sports events, gallery, and a note from the Director of BITS Pilani.

fields.name: Oasis '20 Website
fields.text_1: Oasis—the cultural fest of BITS Pilani—is nothing but 96 hours of unadulterated thrills comprising music, dance, drama, art, quizzes, fashion, and humour. With a footfall of around 5000+ every year, it is the second-largest cultural festival of India.
fields.text_2: This was the Official Website for Oasis'20. It eased the Registrations for all the events, some of which were paid. Users could also Login through the website itself.

fields.name: Hostel Allocation Portal 2021
fields.text_1: The hostel allocation was a crucial project under the guidance of the chief warden, sir. Ensuring the smooth return and settlement of students on campus.
fields.text_2: The hostel allocation portal facilitated students to fill in their wing preferences with a wing size of 5, and also they were allowed to choose the members in their wing.

fields.name: Vaccination Portal 2021
fields.text_1: Vaccination Portal was a portal used by all the students of Bits Pilani, prior to coming on campus. The portal allows the student to upload vaccination certificate and detects whether the student is fully vaccinated or has got only the first dose.
fields.text_2: This project was done by DVM under the guidance of Chief Warden

fields.name: Bits Premier League 2021
fields.text_1: After more than a year-long wait and boredom due to the pandemic, all of us have been waiting to taste the campus life. Sports events are an integral part of our campus life and a way to bond among our peers. We have an exciting event lined up for you. We present BITS Premier League (BPL), a competition for everyone to showcase their talents and strive to be the best. It consisted of BOSM-ignition event which was a sports event for online games like Valorant, BGMI, CSGO. DVM handled the registrations and confirmations through the website.
fields.text_2: ​​BITS Premier League (BPL), a competition for everyone to showcase their talents and strive to be the best. The event consists of various sports tournaments including Cricket, Ultimate Frisbee, Athletics, Football, Table Tennis and many more. The online games included are CSGO, Valorant, CODM and FIFA. It is an inter-BITS competition for which more than 150 students participated and it ignited the sports spirit in BITS Pilani Campus for 2 weeks.

fields.name: APOGEE'22 App
fields.text_1: APOGEE (A Professions Oriented Gathering over Educational Experiences) - is BITS Pilani's annual technical extravaganza. From presenting papers and projects at the oldest-of-its-kind events in the country, developing amazing solutions to real-life cases and problems, exhibitions of the best contraptions that man has made, guest lectures that tell stories never heard before, to the college’s own literature festival, APOGEE challenges the intellect of the participants and piques the minds of the audience.
fields.text_2: APOGEE 2022 promises a plethora of events and activities for everyone ranging from the Prof shows, Tech talks, exhibitions, quizzes, and a number of events related to science, engineering and technology. This APOGEE, DVM presents to you the official APOGEE Android App. The features are - APOGEE Wallet (You can add money to your wallet using your credit card, debit card or net banking.) You can also add a balance from your SWD account (only for bitsians). Get a gist of all your transactions. You can also receive and transfer amounts from one wallet to another. Directly place your order from the wallet - no need to wait in lines. ( PFA - the guide to use the wallet ) QR Code-based sign-ups: Every app user (BITSians and Registered Outstation Participants) can buy Prof Show tickets on their QR code. The verification will also be done using the same. Other features like viewing ongoing events, filtering events, maps, notifications, favourites and emergency contacts.
